entities.summary: Burg Schlaining is a castle in Stadtschlaining in the Austrian state of Burgenland. Burg Schlaining is 378 metres (1,240 ft) above sea level. Today, Burg Schlaining is home to the Austrian Study Centre for Peace and Conflict Resolution.
